Who We Are

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me , Do the Right Thing , and Get Things Done . These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.
OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
About The Opportunity
We're looking for a hands-on product manager to drive growth across our platform's trading and asset business — spot, perpetuals, TradFi, and beyond. You'll ship the product features behind our growth programs, run the campaigns (including token-listing campaigns) that power them, and grow the trading volume and assets they generate — owning the full lifecycle from requirements and delivery through launch, execution, data, and iteration.

We are currently seeking a high calibre professional to join our team as a Product Specialist
In this role you will:
• Increase the private bank's share of discretionary and mutual funds assets by providing a solid client-focused platform.
• Provide best in class internal and external client-focused support, marketing, and aftersales activities, on an effective, efficient and compliant infrastructure.

• Relevant experience in managed solutions, in Wealth Management and/or Asset Management Industry
• Excellent communication skill including ability to present complex financial concepts and strategies
• Strong knowledge across asset classes, portfolio construction and portfolio management

• A good team player
• Bachelor or graduate degree is required

item.title: [C] Brokerage Business Development Manager — HSBC
item.description:
HSBC Life is a world-class institution where you can specialize in Insurance but enjoy the advantages that come with being part of a leading global international bank. Insurance is about people, and the promises they make.At HSBC Life we help deliver on these promises by providing a wide variety of life insurance products and services to our clients throughout the Asia-Pacific Region. Our Employees enjoy a dynamic and innovative workplace and a world of opportunities to develop their careers in a high-profile growing business segment. We empower our team of high-performing individuals to build skills and explore new experiences to realise the full potential of being part of HSBC.Together we pursue efficient ways of working. We harness the latest data and technology solutions to achieve meaningful outcomes for our clients. The protection we offer creates broad and lasting impact, helping clients to be healthier, more productive and more confident in their futures.

• Handle basic customer feedback or complaints on the floor
• Execute service recovery within approved guidelines
